goal: Close the gap the design-system-pass intent's own INTENT CHECK flagged: build the 3 real reference screens it named (wallet-switcher, lock-settings, network-peers) that have no popup counterpart yet, and apply the already-built shared loading/error primitives to the screens that still lack them, over backend/domain support that already exists end to end.
outcome: A user can open a wallet switcher from the main screen to see all stored wallets and switch the active one; open lock/auto-lock settings to trigger an immediate lock or pick an auto-lock timeout; open network/peers settings to view the gateway, add/remove HyperBEAM peers, and toggle/activate one. NetworkErrorBanner and SkeletonRow (already built and already used in main-screen and activity) are applied consistently to send, receive, upload, connected-apps, and the 3 new screens, so no screen invents its own one-off loading/error state. The dead ScreenHeader re-export in packages/ui/src/components/onboarding/index.ts, confirmed to have zero remaining importers repo-wide, is deleted along with its stale comment.

requirements.statement: No new business logic beyond the minimum read-side addition needed to expose already-implemented write paths: setLockSettings (wallet-lifecycle.ts:444) and setNetworkSettings (background/index.ts:239) are already fully implemented and wired -- only a getLockSettings and a getNetworkSettings read method need adding to ProtocolMap (packages/messaging/src/protocol.ts) and wiring to the existing private loadLockSettings/loadNetworkSettings implementations, matching the existing getState/getBalance/getActivity read-method pattern already on the protocol.

wallet-switcher needs no new backend: getState() (wallet-lifecycle.ts) already returns { wallets, activeWalletId, session } sufficient to list wallets and mark the active one; switchWallet(req: { walletId }) is already implemented and wired. Build the popup screen against these directly.

cross-cutting-states is not a new screen or new component: NetworkErrorBanner and SkeletonRow already exist in packages/ui/src/components/wallet/ and are already applied in main-screen and activity. Apply these same existing components to send, receive, upload, and connected-apps (confirmed to currently use neither), and to the 3 new screens where their own reference mockups call for the corresponding state -- do not build new or parallel loading/error primitives.

Delete the ScreenHeader re-export block (and its stale 'backward compatibility' comment) from packages/ui/src/components/onboarding/index.ts -- confirmed via repo-wide grep to have zero remaining importers of ScreenHeader from that barrel path.

settings-home and wallet-detail (TODO.md 7.2/7.4) are explicitly out of scope for this intent -- noted as a real, separate gap (same UI-only-over-complete-backend shape) but not built here, since the design-system-pass intent this closes only named 4 screens, not these two.

wallet-switcher.html, lock-settings.html, and network-peers.html each have a corresponding, functioning popup screen reachable from the main screen / settings, visually matching their reference HTML per the design-system-pass intent's own visual-parity rules (single-warning-red-accent, token-only styling, brand voice/copy).

send, receive, upload, and connected-apps show NetworkErrorBanner on a network-unreachable condition and SkeletonRow (or the equivalent already-established skeleton pattern) while their respective data loads, matching main-screen/activity's existing usage.

getLockSettings and getNetworkSettings are callable through the same messaging dispatcher choke point as every other read method, respecting the existing PROVIDER_METHODS/APPROVAL_METHODS/KEY_METHODS privilege-tier boundary (these are wallet-owner-only reads, not page-originated-accessible).
pnpm wxt build succeeds and every existing layer's own test suite still passes; packages/ui/src/components/onboarding/index.ts no longer exports ScreenHeader.
